# Godot 4 rig player — standalone character preview

**What it creates:** one self-contained Godot project with independent pivot
joint nodes for head/body/arms/legs, ears and face elements parented to head,
a built-in deterministic timeline player, and a source-provenance report.

**Input:** validated `rig.json` + full-canvas transparent PNGs generated by
the Character Factory, and a `scene_spec.json` using one of the supported
action names. The provided `examples/bunny_scene.json` performs six actions
in a 12-second scene at 30 fps.

## Export for preview (not necessarily approved artwork)

    kidsstudio export-godot /local/characters/bunny/v02/rig.json \
      --scene examples/bunny_scene.json \
      --out /local/characters/bunny/preview-godot

The export directory must NOT exist and must be OUTSIDE a Git working tree.
It copies local PNGs and creates `project.godot`, `main.tscn`,
`scripts/rig_player.gd`, `rig.json`, `scene_spec.json`
and `export_report.json`.

With Godot 4 installed locally:

    godot --headless --path /local/characters/bunny/preview-godot \
      --write-movie /local/characters/bunny/preview.avi \
      --fixed-fps 30 --quit-after 360

Optional local FFmpeg transcode:

    ffmpeg -i /local/characters/bunny/preview.avi \
      -c:v libx264 -crf 20 -pix_fmt yuv420p \
      /local/characters/bunny/preview.mp4

Because ComfyUI is installed on the owner's Mac, **GitHub CI cannot run
the real character render**, but the exporter and timeline validations are
covered by offline tests. Godot headless runtime validation is still pending.

## Stronger internal quality gate

    kidsstudio export-godot /local/characters/bunny/v02/rig.json \
      --scene examples/bunny_scene.json \
      --out /local/characters/bunny/approved-project \
      --require-reviewed \
      --review-report /local/characters/bunny/v02/visual_review.json \
      --evidence /local/characters/bunny/v02/review/motion_evidence.json

This checks:
- Rig technical validity and shared-canvas transparent layers.
- Local independent visual review status PASS on the exact evidence SHA.
- Current manifest and PNG SHA hashes equal the evaluated visual evidence.
- Contact sheet SHA matches the reviewed evidence.

The accepted artifact status reads
`INTERNAL_RIG_QA_PASSED_NOT_PUBLICATION_APPROVED`; no automatic public
video upload is part of this flow.

## Limitations

- Only top-level one-character 2D rig actions; no final camera/story choreography.
- Rotation joints are not yet deformable mesh/skeleton animation.
- Godot player is generated into the local project; GitHub CI only checks the
  Python generator and mock images, not live installed Godot runtime.
- The local vision model can still overlook subtle defects, and an AI PASS is
  not a guarantee of artistic correctness.
